theme: ISO window ADDISO+DIFFISO/ISOAGE gate; PARSEMS signed fix

weaknesses.title: LOCAL stamps reparsed as UTC — ISOAGE skew by TZ hours
weaknesses.detail: ISOAGE on SYS LOCAL yields ~-10800 on UTC+3. ADDISO on LOCAL stamps rewrites with Z. Prefer DATE UTC.

weaknesses.title: ISO offsets still ignored in ADDISO/DIFFISO path
weaknesses.detail: DIFFISO +01:00 vs Z same wall → 0 not -3600. Offset stamps normalize to wrong Z.

weaknesses.title: ADDISO duration floors sub-second to 0s
weaknesses.detail: ADDISO stamp 500ms → ADDISO_SECS=0 no shift. Sub-second windows impossible.

weaknesses.title: Was: PARSEMS -30s ULONG wrap to LONG_MAX (fixed this iter)
weaknesses.detail: strtoull('-30') wrapped; ADDISO produced year 292279044. Fixed: leading ± sign on whole duration. Still document as was/now.

weaknesses.title: SYS PUSH is bag not string concat
weaknesses.detail: Prefixing '-' via PUSH yields multi-line bag; agents must PARSEMS± or numeric negate.

workarounds: Pin UTC DATE/Z only; never LOCAL for ISOAGE
Reject offset stamps or require trailing Z
Use PARSEMS signed or numeric ADDISO for rewind
language_gaps: LOCAL-aware ISO dual or zone flag
String concat helper distinct from bag PUSH
issues_faced: fixed PARSEMS signed duration (ULONG wrap) + proof
